mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_template SET name=#{name}, valid_start_at=#{validStartAt}, valid_end_at=#{validEndAt}, rule_json=#{ruleJson}, version=version + 1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{templateId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND issued_count=0 AND status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT id, canonical_version, params_sha256, params_canonical, status, receipt_json FROM command_idempotency WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO command_idempotency(id, request_key, canonical_version, params_sha256, params_canonical, status, receipt_json, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestKey}, #{canonicalVersion}, #{paramsSha256}, #{paramsCanonical}, 'RESERVED', NULL, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE command_idempotency SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', receipt_json = #{receiptJson}, succeeded_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} AND status = 'RESERVED'
